_meta.description: WhatsApp Cloud API template submission spec for CP4U / Sunrise Recruit
_meta.submitVia: Meta Business Manager > WhatsApp Manager > Message Templates > Create Template
_meta.note: For bilingual templates, submit TWO separate templates with same `name`, different `language` code.

en.text:
Hi {{1}},

Thanks for sending your CV to Sunrise Recruit. We've added you to our talent database.

Our consultants will be in touch when a suitable role opens up. You can also explore live openings at https://www.sunriserecruit.com/jobs

If you'd prefer not to receive updates, reply STOP.

— The Sunrise Recruit Team
Sunrise Recruit | Connecting People for You

如不希望收到更新，请回复 STOP。

— Sunrise Recruit 团队
Sunrise Recruit | 为您连接人才
